name: Spoils of War
summary: As the Dragonmaw move, Valstag Ironjaw seeks timber and iron from Menethil Harbor. He needs them to strengthen the town’s defenses.

sections.title: Harbor Stores
sections.body: Menethil Harbor once served the Old Horde as a staging ground for an invasion of Hillsbrad. The fleet built there drew on resources stolen from Khaz Modan. Some supplies remain in the harbor, and Valstag asks you to bring him the timber and iron for the town’s defenses.

sections.title: A New Supply
sections.body: Valstag thanks you for bringing the materials. With them, the town need not depend only on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine.

faq.q: What does Valstag need from Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Valstag asks you to recover Khaz Modan timber and iron from Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why are Khaz Modan supplies in the harbor?
faq.answer: The Old Horde built a fleet at Menethil Harbor using resources stolen from Khaz Modan.

faq.q: What will the materials be used for?
faq.answer: Valstag says the materials will help strengthen the town’s defenses as the Dragonmaw move.
Valstag Ironjaw asks you to recover timber and iron from Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Where did the Old Horde use Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: The Old Horde used Menethil Harbor as a staging ground for its naval invasion of Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why does Valstag welcome these supplies?
faq.answer: The materials mean the town need not depend only on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help strengthen the town’s defenses against the Dragonmaw.
As a dwarf, you may know the Old Horde built its fleet here with resources stolen from Khaz Modan.
